sources.entry: paddleocr - Multilingual OCR and document parsing toolkit based on PaddlePaddle.

summary.one_liner: PaddleOCR is an open-source OCR and document AI toolkit built on PaddlePaddle that converts PDFs and images into structured Markdown or JSON and recognizes text in many languages.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes three main areas: document parsing via the PaddleOCR-VL vision-language models and PP-StructureV3, which output Markdown or JSON with coordinate information such as table cell and text positions; scene text recognition via the PP-OCRv6 model, which covers 50 languages in a single unified model; and developer tooling. The tooling includes ONNX model export, acceleration through OpenVINO, ONNX Runtime, or TensorRT, multi-GPU and multi-process parallel inference, and serving so it can be integrated into C++, C#, Java and other applications. Recent release notes also mention Office document (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) to Markdown conversion, DOCX export of parsed results, a browser inference SDK (PaddleOCR.js), and Hugging Face Transformers as an inference backend. The README names integrations with Dify, RAGFlow, Pathway, and Cherry Studio.
use_cases: convert scanned PDFs to Markdown for RAG pipelines
extract text and tables from document images
multilingual text recognition in photos or screenshots
parse documents into JSON for LLM ingestion
run OCR on edge, mobile, or server hardware
integrate OCR into C++, C#, or Java applications
how_to_run: Try the online Experience Center on the official website (no setup required)
Follow the PP-OCR documentation for local text recognition
Follow the PaddleOCR-VL documentation for document parsing
Follow the PP-StructureV3 documentation for structure-aware conversion
See the More Capabilities documentation for ONNX export and high-performance inference
See the Serving documentation for C++, C#, and Java integration
notable: PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 is a 0.9B-parameter vision-language model for document parsing, reported at 96.3% on OmniDocBench v1.6
PP-OCRv6 uses one model for 50 languages, with tiny, small, and medium size tiers
Structured output includes table cell and text coordinates (PP-StructureV3)
Supports multiple inference backends: Paddle static graph, Paddle dynamic graph, and Transformers
Official browser inference SDK (PaddleOCR.js) for running PP-OCRv5 in the browser
caveats: Depends on the PaddlePaddle framework; the README gives per-version install guidance rather than a single command
Some features need optional dependencies installed separately, since core and optional dependencies are split
Model download sources and hardware support vary by backend (NVIDIA GPU, Intel CPU, Kunlunxin XPU, and other accelerators named)
